brief: Start in a dimly lit silo shaft with a lift teaching mechanism. Travel upward through stacked metal floors and catwalks, fighting monsters perched on ledges. Reach a bright control room at the top for your exit. The vertical layout creates distinct zones of light and shadow.
landmarks: Metal lift shaft with teaching platform
pacing_notes: Build tension through vertical progression with increasing light levels and combat intensity.

rubric_hints.navigation: Use the lift as a teach/test point to orient players to vertical movement mechanics
rubric_hints.pacing: Progression should alternate between tight catwalk combat and open control room spaces
rubric_hints.mechanics: Lift teaching platform should demonstrate key vertical traversal skills before combat
rubric_hints.affordances: Ledge positions provide both tactical advantage and visual cues for monster placement
rubric_hints.narrative: The contrast between dark shaft and bright top creates a clear story arc of ascending toward light

seed.structure: ground start -> lift teach -> mid catwalk fight -> top control room exit
seed.mechanics: lift as teach/test; monsters on ledges; health on landings
seed.tone: echoing metal, bright top vs dark shaft
